subject: problem with posterior covariance matrix for fixed effects

messages.author: 58acd2f2d6929a53
messages.subject: problem with posterior covariance matrix for fixed effects
parts:
baeed on what I read in  ? control.fixed,
I am trying to get the posterior covariance matrix for fixed effects.

When I use:
v<-inla(y~x,control.fixed(correlation.matrix=T),data=dat,family = "gaussian",control.predictor=list(compute=T))

or

v<-inla(y~x,control.fixed(correlation.matrix=T),data=dat,family = "gaussian",
control.inla=list(lincomb.derived.correlation.matrix=TRUE))

and then
v$misc$lincomb.derived.covariance.matrix,
I get NULL

and obviously v$misc shows:
$lincomb.derived.correlation.matrix
NULL
$lincomb.derived.covariance.matrix
NULL

I am puzzled - especially when it seems that it should work (based on reading a previous post in the discussion list).
Can you point me to what is wrong?

All the Best
 Marek
